meta.source: design-system/tokens.json in the Celine Studio Website repo
meta.generated: src/app/tokens.css is generated from this file by scripts/build-tokens.mjs (npm run tokens). Never edit tokens.css by hand.
meta.rules: Use the token, never the raw value. A value that is missing gets a token here first.
meta.extensions: Fields the Claude Design system format does not read, used by the site generator: type style `fluid` (clamp() size), `transform`; token `lg` (value from the lg breakpoint up); `cssValue` (value used on the site when it differs from the portable one).
